subject: computer-science
title: Ethical, Legal & Environmental Issues: Apply
welcome_lead: Real-world scenarios — match each to the right law or principle.
meta_desc: GCSE Computer Science adventure applying ethics and law to real scenarios like AI and privacy.
final_note: You can analyse computing situations from legal and ethical angles.

concepts.def: Right to control your personal information.
Unfair AI decisions due to flawed training data.
Gap between those with and without tech access.
Software whose code anyone can view and edit.

walkthroughs.body_html: An app harvesting contacts without consent breaks DPA 2018. Even with consent, only the data needed for the stated purpose should be processed (the minimisation principle).
A hiring AI trained mostly on male CVs may unfairly reject women. Bias issues: training data, feature choice and feedback loops. Solutions: diverse data and audits.
Households without reliable internet struggle with online homework, banking and job hunting. Closing the gap involves cheaper devices, public Wi-Fi and digital skills training.
